intervals merge [[1,2],[4,5]] gap default 0: 4-2-1=1 <= 0? no → separate ✓. gap 1 → 1<=1 merge ✓. [[10,12],[0,1],[5,6]] gap3: sorted (0,1),(5,6),(10,12): 5-1-1=3<=3 merge (0,6); 10-6-1=3<=3 merge (0,12) ✓.

subtract [[0,4]] hole (4,9) → h_hi 9 >= lo0, h_lo 4 <= hi4 → intersect; lo<=h_lo-1 (0<=3) → (0,3); h_hi+1=10<=4 false → [(0,3)] ✓.
